scope: Post-hoc development analysis; methods fixed before fitting these new policies, after earlier selection-split results were inspected.

calibration.objective: mean binary log loss plus 0.01*slope^2/2; intercept unpenalized
calibration.weights: Equal questions; equal rounds and rotations within each question
calibration.degenerate_labels: Keep smoothed initial intercept and zero slope

stop_policies.calibration_selected_fixed: Highest mean calibration reward; ties within 1e-12 prefer PASS then earlier round
stop_policies.myopic: First round with calibrated correctness probability strictly greater than 1/(1+correct_reward); otherwise PASS
stop_policies.threshold_rule: First round with calibrated correctness probability >= threshold; otherwise PASS
stop_policies.threshold_selection: Highest mean calibration episodic reward over grid and explicit PASS; ties within 1e-12 prefer PASS then higher threshold

factorization.native_schedule: First A-D commitment from the validated native WAIT condition; same stopping round is replayed with each answer source
primary_contrasts: Plain minus WAIT answers under the identical native WAIT stopping schedule
Plain minus WAIT answers under the identical WAIT-derived myopic stopping schedule
Plain minus WAIT answers under the identical WAIT-derived calibration-selected threshold stopping schedule
secondary_contrasts: Own-source plain versus WAIT external pipelines
Own-source plain and WAIT external pipelines versus native WAIT
Full crossed answer-source and stop-source policy tables

plain_cyclic_ensemble.rule: Arithmetic mean of canonical candidate probabilities across all four cyclic rotations at each question/menu/round; choose canonical A-D argmax
plain_cyclic_ensemble.candidate_tie_break: First canonical label in A-D order
plain_cyclic_ensemble.calibration: Separate per-menu fit with the same fixed hyperparameters on 20 calibration questions times five rounds
plain_cyclic_ensemble.comparison: Complete ensemble pipeline versus the corresponding four-order-averaged plain pipeline, paired by question
plain_cyclic_ensemble.invariance_scope: Invariant by construction to reindexing the closed four-cyclic-rotation group; no claim about all 24 permutations or the underlying model

evaluation.bootstrap_unit: Question; retain all menu, round, rotation and paired-condition observations
evaluation.interval_scope: Descriptive percentile intervals conditional on fixed fitted calibrators and selected policies; omit fitting/model-selection uncertainty and multiplicity correction
evaluation.policy_fitting_order: Fit and select using only calibration states, save the frozen parameter/selection receipt, then compute selection policy outcomes

limitations: The selection questions were already inspected; this is not prospective confirmation or a fresh test.
A myopic positive-EV comparison with PASS does not estimate continuation value or solve optimal stopping.
Pooled-round correctness calibration does not guarantee calibration at each round or after policy-induced selection.
Crossed stopping schedules derived for one answer source are diagnostic interventions, not claims that their calibrated probabilities apply to another answer source.
Ensembling changes both answer probabilities and fitted calibration; its comparison is a complete-pipeline contrast.
Forty real questions remain the sample; rotations and counterfactual states do not increase the independent question count.
